newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila water privatisation shared by two groups.
newsitem.headline: Manila water privatisation shared by two groups.

text.p: A consortium comprising Ayala Corp, Bechtel Corp of the United States and Britain's United Utilities posted the lowest bids for both zones in the Manila waterworks privatisation, officials said on Thursday.
The consortium will, however, be considered to have posted the best bid in only the east zone, Metropolitan Water and Sewerage System (MWSS) officials said.

A consortium consisting of French utility Lyonnaise des Eaux SA and Benpres Holdings Corp will be considered as the best bidder for the west zone, under a formula which prevents the same bidder from winning both concessions, they said. This group posted the second-best bid for the west zone.

The other two groups which had vied for the contract to modernise and run Manila's outmoded water system were Anglian Water Plc along with Australia Water Technologies Pty Ltd and Metro Pacific Corp and Compagnie Generale des Eaux with Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc
The Ayala, Bechtel and United Utilities combine offered to supply water in the east zone at a cost equal to 26.3886 percent of the existing tariff which is at 8.78 pesos per litre.
In the west zone, the consortium offered at 28.633 percent.
However, the Lyonnaise-Benpres consortium's offer, at 56.5922 percent, was considered the best under rules set by the International Finance Corporation which is overseeing the privatisation process.
The winning bidders, who will take over services for a period of 25 years, are expected to invest a total of $7.0 billion to improve the MWSS system.
